articles.title: Ram Temple CEO race narrows to three candidates, final pick to be announced today
articles.summary: After careful consideration, the search committee has identified three potential candidates for the CEO position. Each candidate, originating from Uttar Pradesh, carries a unique blend of experience relevant to the role.

articles.title: ‘Pre-event indications’: Did Nepal miss warning signs before deadly floods?
articles.summary: A glacier collapse in Nepal and China showed visible signs days before the disaster. Scientists noted brown meltwater and a propagating crack as pre-event indications.

articles.title: Times Square stabbing: Bank of America VP Erin Piacenti among victims
articles.summary: A shocking event unfolded on Monday in Times Square as a vice president of Bank of America was violently stabbed in an unprovoked attack. Armed with kitchen knives, a woman assaulted two people before police intervened, resulting in her death.

articles.title: Amid 'very long meetings' and running chess world, has Anand lost 'hunger' to win?
articles.summary: Viswanathan Anand is juggling two contrasting roles at this time. He is the interim FIDE President and also a competitive chess player.

Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial: Matt Walsh denounces her online defenders; jury remains deadlocked
articles.summary: In the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, jurors remain unable to agree on a verdict. Matt Walsh, a conservative commentator, has openly criticized defenses aimed at portraying Clancy as a devoted mother.

articles.title: Streamer Eyes Twitch Switch: Clavicular says he has a deal; fans debate Kick future
articles.summary: Clavicular says he plans to start streaming on Twitch within about a week and claims he has a deal with the platform. His comments have divided fans, with some expecting trouble on Twitch and others questioning the deal itself.

articles.summary: India Post is now open for registrations for Gramin Dak Sevak roles, welcoming eligible candidates to submit their applications online until September 21, 2026. Candidates can correct their applications from September 23 to 24.

articles.title: KVS NVS Tier-II result 2026 out: Final answer key released for TGT and Senior Secretariat Assistant posts; check direct links here
articles.summary: KVS NVS Tier-II result 2026: CBSE released Tier-II recruitment results for selected KVS and NVS posts on September 1, 2026, along with the final answer key. The latest declaration covers TGT Social Science, TGT Special Educator, TGT English and Senior Secretariat Assistant.

articles.title: Ministry of Education extends NMMS scholarship 2026-27 deadline to September 30
articles.summary: The Education Ministry has extended the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship application deadline. Students can now apply until September 30, 2026, through the National Scholarship Portal.

articles.title: CISF ASI Paramedical admit card 2026 released: PST starts September 14, check documents and direct link here
articles.summary: CISF ASI Paramedical admit card 2026: CISF released the ASI Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2026 PST and Documentation admit cards on September 1. The physical and documentation stage is scheduled to begin on September 14.

articles.title: Jungkook: 'I have a certain type of person I'm looking for' - WATCH
articles.summary: BTS star Jungkook's viral video described ideal qualities for a video team member. He sought someone talkative, passionate, and interested in fashion and fitness.

articles.title: George and Amal Clooney arrive in Venice for the Venice Film Festival
articles.summary: As Venice prepares for its esteemed film festival, George and Amal Clooney have graced the city with their presence. George is poised to receive the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement, while Amal showcased her fashion sense in a chic olive-green skirt suit with subtle accessories.

articles.title: Bhagyashree on motherhood and fitness
articles.summary: Actress Bhagyashree opened up about her experiences with early motherhood and navigating postpartum fitness. Both of her deliveries were C-sections, which raised some concerns initially.

articles.title: Who was Neem Karoli Baba?
articles.summary: Vishal Chaturvedi's 'Hanuman Ansh' brings to life the spiritual journey of Neem Karoli Baba, an esteemed Hindu teacher known for his deep compassion. The film intricately depicts the path of Lakshman Das, showcasing his quest for divine love and spiritual awakening.
